verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's crawl feature (firecrawl-gh-3, firecrawl-gh-4, firecrawl-docs-21) confirms it can crawl an entire site and discover all URLs, implying some traversal strategy and page discovery, but no evidence explicitly documents a configurable 'breadth-first' strategy or an explicit max-page-limit parameter. missing for 10: explicit documentation of breadth-first vs depth-first crawl strategy option, explicit max page limit configuration parameter, independent verification of crawl ordering behavior.
